title: Acromial Morphology: Reliability of CT-based Assessment and Relationship With Age in a Series of 420 Patients
official: Acromial Morphology: Reliability of CT-based Assessment and Relationship With Age in a Series of 420 Patients
summary: This study evaluates the reliability of CT-based assessment of acromial morphology and its relationship with age, in order to improve understanding of shoulder pathologies such as subacromial impingement and rotator cuff tears.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects aged 20 to 89 years
* Shoulder CT or arthro-CT performed at Strasbourg University Hospitals
* Examination performed between 02/01/2009 and 11/12/2023
* Independent indication for imaging
* No documented opposition to reuse of medical data for research

Exclusion Criteria:

* Imaging not performed
* Poor image quality
* Inability to perform 3D reconstruction
* Duplicate examination within the same age group
* History of acromial fracture
* Previous surgery interfering with acromial analysis (arthroplasty, acromioplasty, osteosynthesis, arthrodesis)
* Shoulder pathology interfering with acromial analysis (severe acromioclavicular arthropathy, humeral head osteonecrosis, glenohumeral dysplasia)
